title: Beetle King Ritual
description: A beetle-like humanoid figure wearing a crown and ornate robe stands on the left, holding a dripping bloody heart in one hand and a smoking pipe in the other. To the right, a table draped in blue velvet holds lit candles, an embroidered pillow, and papers, while a large circular portal in the background reveals a horned shadowy demon with glowing pink eyes surrounded by orange pods.
prompt: A grotesque beetle humanoid wearing a royal crown and multicolored patterned robe stands holding a bloody human heart in one hand and a smoking pipe in the other. A blue velvet table in front holds several lit candles, a white embroidered pillow with purple patterns, and papers. In the background a large ornate circular portal frames a towering black horned shadow demon with glowing pink eyes and orange seed pods around its head, dark fantasy style with green smoke and floating skulls
